query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS institutional_memory (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portfolio',
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  category ENUM('Mission','Process','Decision','Lesson','Principle','Vision','Non-Negotiable','Cultural') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Lesson',
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  tags VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '',
  author VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'Founder',
  importance ENUM('Critical','High','Medium','Low') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medium',
  is_founder_legacy TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_public TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  linked_decision_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
  view_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000),
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compliance_frameworks (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  short_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  category ENUM('Social','Environmental','Governance','Legal','Certification') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Governance',
  description TEXT,
  applies_to VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT 'all',
  total_requirements INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compliance_requirements (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  framework_id INT NOT NULL,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portfolio',
  requirement_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  priority ENUM('Critical','High','Medium','Low') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medium',
  status ENUM('Not Started','In Progress','Compliant','Non-Compliant','Exempt','Under Review') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Not Started',
  evidence TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  due_date BIGINT DEFAULT NULL,
  completed_at BIGINT DEFAULT NULL,
  owner VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000),
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stakeholder_interactions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  stakeholder_id INT NOT NULL,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portfolio',
  interaction_type ENUM('Meeting','Email','Call','Presentation','Workshop','Negotiation','Conflict','Resolution','Other') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Meeting',
  date BIGINT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  sentiment ENUM('Very Positive','Positive','Neutral','Negative','Very Negative') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Neutral',
  commitments TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  follow_up_actions TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  follow_up_due BIGINT DEFAULT NULL,
  mission_alignment_impact ENUM('Strengthened','Neutral','Weakened') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Neutral',
  recorded_by VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'Founder',
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000)
);
